messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: capacity-exhaustion-inference-queue (P1)
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: Triggered -> Acknowledgement pending

alice: I got the page, jumping in. oncall shift. Starting triage.

bob: on-call, pulling metrics. seeing queue backlog on inference-requests-prod (us-west-2) - queue depth ~12k, p95 latency spiking.

carol: autoscaler logs show scale decision stuck: KubeAPI 429s to aws-autoscaler; control-plane requests throttled. Might be cloud/provider quota related.

alice: can we manual-scale to unblock? what's minReplicas?

carol: minReplicas=2, target CPU-based HPA not reconciling because of control-plane throttling. Suggest manual scale to 10 replicas on pool inference-gpu-usw2 to buy time.

alice: I'll run manual scale now.

alice: (running)
```
kubectl --context=prod scale deployment/inference-gpu --replicas=10 -n inference
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-gpu -n inference
```

alice: K8s accepted scale, pods pending due to node quota (spot pool empty) - pods Unable to schedule: Insufficient resources.

dave: I'll spin up a temporary dedicated pool. Creating reserved instances and attaching.

dave: (running infra script)
```
./infra/scripts/allocate-dedicated-pool --region=us-west-2 --size=8 --type=gpu-v100
```

dave: Pool requested, hitting cloud quota on GPUs (quota 20), currently at 19. Requesting quota bump with cloud console — ETA ~10-15m.

erin-support: Customers seeing elevated 502/503 on hosted API in us-west; support ticket volume climbing. Posting dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/d/rr/inference-errors?org=prod

bob: fallback idea: route non-critical traffic to smaller CPU-quantized model (l-quant) in eu-west while we spin up capacity. Can enable circuit-breaker style routing.

carol: pushing a routing change to redirect 30% of dev and 10% of low-priority prod traffic to l-quant in eu-west to reduce pressure.

alice: executing routing change (ksonnet patch), snippet below.
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  route_policy: |
    - match: "request.priority == 'low'"
      action: redirect(region: eu-west, model: l-quant)
```

alice: Route change posted, observing ~8% drop in us-west queue depth already.

pagerduty: Acknowledged by alice

pagerduty: Escalation queued to bob after 5m if not resolved

bob: continuing monitoring, queue depth down to 6.1k, tail latency still high for long-seq requests. Trend looks positive.

carol: autoscaler control-plane errors cleared (~12:41). HPA reconcile backfill starting, node provisioning in progress; expect additional pods in ~5-7m.

dave: cloud quota bump approved and applied. Dedicated pool creation in progress.

alice: manual intervention + routing seems to have stabilized user-facing errors. Support ticket surge plateauing.

erin-support: Confirming customer impact: ~12% of requests in us-west returned 502s during 12:29-12:37 window. Affected tenants: tid-221, tid-907. Retries mitigated some client-side impact.

alice: will keep thread open; initiating handoff to next oncall @bob in 10m.

bob: ack, taking over monitoring. Creating follow-up runbook item: autoscaler warmup and increase minReplicas to 4 for inference pools.

carol: filing infra PR to increase default minReplicas and add exponential backoff/retries for KubeAPI calls in autoscaler. Also adding a new alert for repeated reconcile 429s (alert: autoscaler-reconcile-throttle).

dave: I'll create the postmortem draft and link once done: /incidents/INC-2026-03-autoscaler-throttle

alice: marking incident as mitigated. I'll add timeline + command list to the postmortem and hand off.

pagerduty: Resolved by alice at 1771234633

alice: final note -- root cause: control-plane rate-limited autoscaler (cloud API quota + KubeAPI 429s) leading to scaling lag; mitigation: manual scale + routing fallback + quota bump. Action items: update runbook, bump minReplicas, add autoscaler backoff and health alerts. :white_check_mark:
